# server-quickstart

A stdio weather server exposing `get-alerts` and `get-forecast` tools (`src/index.ts`). It was the source for the retired server-quickstart tutorial; the current getting-started tutorial is [Build your first server](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/blob/cc4b41617ce3601b1290d67216ea0b194a3cd9ac/docs/get-started/first-server.md).

The `package.json` and `tsconfig.json` here are monorepo-internal (`workspace:`/`catalog:` protocols; typecheck-only in CI). To build the server yourself outside the monorepo, copy `src/index.ts` into a standalone project that depends on the published packages.
